questions.stem: A 33-year-old customs officer at an international airport develops fever and jaundice 4 days after returning from a work trip to Brazil. The health authorities suspect yellow fever and initiate specific measures. Which of the following best describes the public health action that should be applied to the officer's co-passengers who are asymptomatic but may have been exposed during travel?

options.label: B
options.text: Quarantine for 10 days with symptom monitoring

options.label: C
options.text: Quarantine for 6 days from last known exposure

options.label: D
options.text: Immediate vaccination and discharge without restriction
